I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread. The main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

- **Where it comes from:** Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. The same trailer showed up twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch also added him by hand. Marcus is a member of #north-team, so he can see that post himself.
- **Other details:** The Quarrendon account page in gbrain also lists Thea as main contact. I told Marcus that Dana has owned the account since June 2025, so she may have more recent news.
- **Left out:** I didn't include the prices or billing figures that came up in the search, since none of that was needed to answer him.
